info.title: fx 0.7.4 · Your repositories as one workspace: for people, for CI and for agents.
info.description: fx, the tool of the Fuxion workspace: its repositories, the shared build of .NET (with Fuxion.Tool.Sdk), the instructions for the coding agents and the versions, from the configuration in _fx/. A native executable for each platform.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: fx ui · the workspace in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a repository to the manifest, mounted where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.

options.name: --root
options.description: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Act on the whole workspace, from anywhere inside it.

options.name: --output
options.description: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More detail, on stderr.

options.name: --plain
options.description: No colors or borders.

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).

commands.name: list
commands.description: The repositories of the manifest: mount point, policy and whether they are mounted.

commands.name: mount
commands.description: Mount repositories: a parked one comes back now; fx sync clones what is missing.

commands.name: pull
commands.description: Fast-forward the mounted repositories that have a clean working tree.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Take a repository out of the manifest; its clone stays.

commands.name: rename
commands.description: Rename a repository: its references in this workspace change, and the old name stays in aliases.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Change a key of a repository: url, path, mount, depends-on or inherits.

commands.name: status
commands.description: The mounted repositories that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.

commands.name: tag
commands.description: Add tags to a repository, or remove them (--remove).

commands.name: unmount
commands.description: Unmount repositories: they are parked in _fx/~$parking/, never deleted.
